ACT XII OF 1989
ACT XII OF 1989
BALOCHISTAN LAWS (ADAPTATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend the Balochistan Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 28th November, 1989]
No.PAB/LEGIS; 111(15)/89, dated
28-11-1989.-- The Balochistan Laws (Adaptation) (Amendment) Bill, 1989 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 18th October, 1989 and
assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Balochistan Laws (Adaptation) (Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 9th day of April, 1989.

Amendment of Part II of Schedule of Balochistan Laws (Adaptation) Order, 197

An Act to amend the Balochistan Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 28th November, 1989]
No.PAB/LEGIS; 111(15)/89, dated
28-11-1989.-- The Balochistan Laws (Adaptation) (Amendment) Bill, 1989 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 18th October, 1989 and
assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
2. Amendment of Part II of Schedule of Balochistan Laws (Adaptation)
Order, 197.--In the Balochistan Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1975, in Part 11
of the Schedule, the following letter, words, figures and commas appearing
after the figure "1961" in column 2, 3 and 4 shall be deleted:--
"VIII.
The West Pakistan Hill Tract Im rovemcnt Ordinance 1961.--
(1) In Subsection (2) of Section
1 omit "Capital of the Federation and the Special Areas" and
substitute "Tribal Areas".
(2) Section 12 to be omitted.
(3) Throughout the Act for the words
"West Pakistan" substitute the word "Balochistan".

Repeal
